query: Which spatially-aware data splits and augmentation strategies (spatial block CV, conditioned realizations) best prevent leakage and test field generalization?

response.query: Which spatially-aware data splits and augmentation strategies (spatial block CV, conditioned realizations) best prevent leakage and test field generalization?
response.answer: Spatial block cross-validation and conditioned realizations are effective strategies to prevent leakage and ensure test field generalization in spatially-aware data splits. These methods maintain spatial integrity and reduce bias.

Session 2aAAb Architectural Acoustics and Noise: Low Frequency Absorption: Mechanisms, Measurement Methods and Application II Peter D’Antonio, Cochair RPG Diffusor Systems, Inc., 651-C Commerce Drive, Upper Marlboro, MD 20774, USA Christian Nocke, Cochair Akustikbüro Oldenburg, Katharinenstr. Martens McGill University, Schulich School of Music, 555 Sherbrooke Street West, Mont-real, QC H3A 1E3, Canada, wlm@music.mcgill.ca In order to enable unbiased observation of the effects of low-frequency absorption on auditory imagery associated with multichannel loudspeaker reproduction, binaural recordings were made of surround sound program material that was reproduced over full-range loudspeakers located in a room that was specially constructed to allow for variation in low-frequency acous-tical treatment.
